Japan.title: Japan's Prime Minister Fumio Kishida faces opposition over planned pension overhaul
Japan.summary: On July 19, 2024, Japan's Prime Minister Fumio Kishida faced opposition from his ruling party and the opposition over a plan to overhaul the country's pension system. The plan aims to increase the pension age from 65 to 69, but it has sparked controversy among older voters who fear they will not have enough time to adapt to the changes.

Japan.title: North Korea fires two ballistic missiles into the Sea of Japan
Japan.summary: On July 21, 2024, North Korea fired two ballistic missiles into the Sea of Japan, prompting the US and Japan to issue joint statements condemning the launches. The missiles were detected by South Korean military radar and the US Space Command.

Japan.title: Japan's ruling party faces election backlash over pension overhaul
Japan.summary: On July 25, 2024, Japan's ruling party faced a backlash from voters over the planned pension overhaul. A recent poll showed that support for the party has declined by 5% since the plans were announced, with many voters expressing concerns about the impact on their retirement savings.
